decisions.reason: The candidate contains several numbered tender positions that require new physical materials. The items below exclude service-only work, temporary site provisions, and accessories included in other products.

items.material_name: Meadow seed mixture
items.description: Seed mix for reinstating disturbed meadow areas, to be agreed with the landowner.

items.material_name: 0/32 mm bedding gravel for DN 800/900 pipes
items.description: Gravel for 120° pipe bedding, 15 cm thick, with sidefill and cover extending 20 cm above the pipe crown.

items.material_name: C12/15 concrete for 20 cm inlet structure bedding
items.description: Concrete supplied, placed to grade, and compacted beneath the inlet structure.

items.material_name: 16/32 mm rounded gravel for trench soil replacement
items.description: Rounded gravel for replacing excavated soil within the DN 800/900 pipe trench.

items.material_name: 0/X cohesive pit-run gravel, non-frost-resistant
items.description: Cohesive pit-run gravel for soil replacement within the pipe trench.

items.material_name: Utility bedding and protective backfill material
items.description: Material to reinstate bedding and protective layers at transverse utility crossings; composition is redacted.

items.material_name: Utility bedding and protective backfill material
items.description: Material to reinstate bedding and protective layers along longitudinal utility crossings; composition is redacted.

items.material_name: C 200/400 armourstone
items.description: Hydraulic armourstone for stream-bank protection, with fine gravel or sand included as void fill.

items.material_name: 0/56 mm frost-protection gravel
items.description: Gravel for the unbound frost-protection course, specified at up to 52 cm total thickness.

items.material_name: 16/32 mm fine-grading gravel
items.description: Gravel for the fine-grading layer above the frost-protection course; no separate quantity is stated.

items.material_name: AC 32 TN asphalt base-course mix, 70/100 binder, 10 cm
items.description: Asphalt concrete base-course mix for placement over the frost-protection layer.

items.material_name: AC 11 DN asphalt surface-course mix, 50/70 binder, 4 cm
items.description: Asphalt concrete surface-course mix supplied and compacted to grade.

items.material_name: Heat-fusible asphalt joint tape, 40 mm course depth, minimum 10 mm width
items.description: TOK-type tape for sealing longitudinal and transverse joints against existing asphalt.

items.material_name: 0/22 mm road shoulder gravel
items.description: Shoulder aggregate for placement up to 50 cm wide and 5–8 cm thick at 6% crossfall.

items.material_name: DN 800 UHPC reinforced concrete pipe, C80/95, 3.00 m length, above LC 250
items.description: FBS-approved socketed pipe with integral elastomeric compression seal; exposure classes XC4, XD3, XF4, XA2, and XM2.

items.material_name: DN 900 UHPC reinforced concrete pipe, C80/95, 3.00 m length, above LC 250
items.description: FBS-approved socketed pipe with integral elastomeric compression seal; exposure classes XC4, XD3, XF4, XA2, and XM2.

items.material_name: DN 800 FBS make-up and articulation piece for UHPC reinforced concrete pipe
items.description: Add-on fitting for dimensional adjustment and articulation in the pipe run.

items.material_name: DN 900 FBS make-up and articulation piece for UHPC reinforced concrete pipe
items.description: Add-on fitting for dimensional adjustment and articulation in the pipe run.

items.material_name: DN 900 FBS bevelled UHPC reinforced concrete pipe end section, 1:1 (45°)
items.description: Add-on pipe end section bevelled to match the embankment slope.

items.material_name: VPC 995 pipe coupling, 925–995 mm clamping range
items.description: Funke or equivalent variable pipe coupling.

items.material_name: DN 1000 tangential manhole, DN 800 to DN 900 transition, 135° bend, 1.50 m depth
items.description: Side-entry manhole with a gradient change, DN 1000 cover slab, and DN 625 access opening.

items.material_name: DN 1000 tangential manhole, straight channel, 1.65 m depth
items.description: Side-entry manhole with a DN 1000 cover slab and DN 625 access opening.

items.material_name: Class B 125 round ventilated cast-iron and concrete manhole cover assembly
items.description: Concrete-filled cast-iron lid and matching frame to DIN EN 124 and DIN 1229.

items.material_name: Class D 400 round ventilated cast-iron and concrete manhole cover assembly
items.description: Concrete-filled cast-iron lid and matching frame to DIN EN 124 and DIN 1229.

items.material_name: Precast reinforced concrete inlet headwall with wing walls, DN 800 socket, 3.00 × 1.20 m base, minimum 20 cm walls
items.description: Inlet structure with a 1.00 × 2.00 m rear wall, straight and sloping sidewalls, and reinforcement; excludes the grille.
